# Copilot instructions

Read and follow the repository-wide [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before changing code. In particular, this workspace is Angular 21.2: verify APIs against the installed version and do not assume Angular 22+ features or defaults.

Follow the [official Angular style guide](https://angular.dev/style-guide). Prefer standalone APIs, signals for local state, built-in template control flow, and accessible semantic HTML. Match this project's Sass, Angular CLI, npm, and Vitest conventions. Keep changes focused, add relevant tests for behavior changes, and run the applicable checks.

Angular's official AI guidance is available at [LLM prompts and AI IDE setup](https://angular.dev/ai/develop-with-ai). The Angular CLI MCP server is configured in `.vscode/mcp.json`.
